title: #207 Home Education
prompt: In some countries, more parents prefer to educate their children themselves at home instead of sending them to school. What are the advantages or disadvantages of it?

promptSegments.text: In some countries, more parents prefer to educate their children themselves at home instead of sending them to school.
What are the advantages or disadvantages of it?

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.
requirements.vi: Thảo luận những ưu điểm và nhược điểm quan trọng.
Đưa ra nhận định tổng thể theo yêu cầu.

requirements.en: Support the comparison with relevant examples.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ phần so sánh bằng ví dụ phù hợp.
